steps.title: Analyze Build Failure
steps.description: Examine the build-error.log to locate the source of the compilation error in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Remove Trailing Backticks in MainActivity
steps.description: Clean up MainActivity.java by deleting the trailing markdown backticks that were accidentally generated at the end of the file.

steps.title: Remove Package Attribute from Manifest
steps.description: Clean up AndroidManifest.xml by removing the deprecated package attribute, specifying namespace through build.gradle instead.

steps.title: Ensure Clean File Endings
steps.description: Double check all source files to verify they end with proper braces and have no trailing syntactic anomalies.

steps.title: Verify Layout Bindings and Widgets
steps.description: Check that the UI element lookups match the layout structure defined in activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Inner Class Compatibility
steps.description: Ensure that the click listeners and game loops use traditional anonymous inner classes to maintain full Java 8 backward compatibility.

steps.title: Verify State Saving and Loading Mechanisms
steps.description: Confirm that match progression and token positions are safely serialized to SharedPreferences and restored upon activity recreate.

steps.title: Check Piece Collision and Movement Logic
steps.description: Validate the collision and capturing rules logic inside the board view and main thread coordinator.

steps.title: Verify Game Loop Thread Safety
steps.description: Check that the programmatic dice roll background animation uses proper handler dispatching back to the main UI thread.

steps.title: Building Ludo Classic
steps.description: Compile the verified codebase using the standard Gradle toolchain.
